title: New node types — HTTP Request, Code/Transform, Switch, Loop, Sub-workflow, Error Trigger
description:
Add 6 new n8n-inspired node types adapted for AI agent orchestration.

**1. HTTP Request node** (type: `http`)
- Config: method (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE), URL, headers (key-value pairs), body template, timeout
- Icon: Globe (lucide)
- Use case: call external APIs, webhooks, or microservices as workflow steps
- Accent: purple

**2. Code/Transform node** (type: `transform`)
- Config: expression (JS-like), input mapping, output mapping
- Icon: Code (lucide)
- Use case: transform data between steps, map/filter arrays, format outputs
- Accent: indigo
- SECURITY: expression stored as string, evaluated server-side in sandboxed runtime (NOT in browser)

**3. Switch node** (type: `switch`)
- Config: expression + N cases (value→branch mappings) + default branch
- Icon: GitMerge (lucide)
- Multiple named output handles (one per case + default). Uses same BaseNode multi-output from condition task.
- Accent: teal

**4. Loop node** (type: `loop`)
- Config: forEach expression (what to iterate), maxIterations (safety cap), parallelism
- Icon: Repeat (lucide)
- Two outputs: loop-body (connects to sub-steps) and done (continues after loop)
- Accent: orange

**5. Sub-workflow node** (type: `sub-workflow`)
- Config: workflowId (select from existing workflows), input mapping
- Icon: Workflow (lucide) or GitBranch
- Use case: compose workflows by calling other workflows
- Accent: cyan

**6. Error Trigger node** (type: `error-trigger`)
- Config: catches errors from specific steps or any step, retry config
- Icon: AlertTriangle (lucide)
- Special: no input handle (triggered by errors), output connects to recovery steps
- Accent: red

For each node: create component in nodes/, add to nodeTypes registry in WorkflowCanvas, add config schema + form fields in NodeConfigPanel, add to BuilderSidebar palette, add to RunOverlayNode status rendering.
definitionOfDone: All 6 node types render in builder with correct icons and colors
Each has config panel with appropriate fields
Switch node has multiple named outputs
Loop node has loop-body and done outputs
Error trigger has no input handle
RunOverlayNode handles new types for run visualization

implementationPlan.description:
Create 6 new node components in `dashboard/src/components/workflow/nodes/`.

All follow existing pattern: memo() wrapper, BaseNode with icon + accent + children.

- `HttpNode.tsx`: Globe icon, purple accent, shows method + URL truncated
- `TransformNode.tsx`: Code icon, indigo accent, shows expression preview
- `SwitchNode.tsx`: GitMerge icon, teal accent, uses multi-output BaseNode (N cases + default). Dynamic outputs from config.cases array.
- `LoopNode.tsx`: Repeat icon, orange accent, dual outputs (loop-body + done)
- `SubWorkflowNode.tsx`: Workflow icon, cyan accent, shows referenced workflow name
- `ErrorTriggerNode.tsx`: AlertTriangle icon, red accent, NO input handle (override BaseNode to skip target Handle)

For ErrorTriggerNode: add optional `hideInput?: boolean` prop to BaseNode.

SECURITY: All config values rendered as text. URL in HttpNode truncated to 60 chars. Expression in TransformNode truncated to 80 chars.

Register all 6 new types in WorkflowCanvas nodeTypes registry and BuilderSidebar palette.

WorkflowCanvas: add to `nodeTypes` object: `http: HttpNode, transform: TransformNode, switch: SwitchNode, loop: LoopNode, 'sub-workflow': SubWorkflowNode, 'error-trigger': ErrorTriggerNode`.

BuilderSidebar: add 6 entries to NODE_TYPES array with type, label, icon, description for each.

Update `nodes/index.ts` barrel export with all new nodes.

Add config schemas and form fields for all 6 types in NodeConfigPanel.

- http: Zod schema with method (enum), url (string, required), headers (optional), body (optional), timeout (number)
- transform: expression (string, required), inputMapping (optional), outputMapping (optional)
- switch: expression (string), cases (array of {value, label}), defaultBranch (string)
- loop: forEach (string), maxIterations (number, default 100, max 10000), parallelism (number)
- sub-workflow: workflowId (string, required — use Select populated from useWorkflows), inputMapping (optional)
- error-trigger: catchFrom (string[] step IDs or 'any'), retryCount (number), retryDelay (string)

SECURITY: URL field for HTTP node: no javascript: or data: schemes (validate with regex). Expression fields stored as strings only. maxIterations capped at 10000 to prevent abuse.

Update RunOverlayNode and transform.ts to handle the 6 new types.

RunOverlayNode: add type icons for http, transform, switch, loop, sub-workflow, error-trigger with matching colors.

transform.ts `normalizeWorkflowNodeType()`: add mappings for new backend type names.

Verify `node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit`.
